query: SELECT district, status, candidate1_name, candidate1_party, candidate2_name, candidate2_party, incumbent, notes FROM house_races WHERE state_code = 'TX' AND district IN (1, 5, 7, 9, 14, 16, 17, 19, 24, 32, 33, 35, 37, 38) ORDER BY district ASC;

rows.notes: Yolanda Prince (D) won the May 26 Democratic primary runoff over Dax Alexander (72.2% vs 27.8%). Nathaniel Moran (R) ran uncontested. Rated Solid R.
Chelsey Hockett (D) won the May 26 Democratic primary runoff over R. Torres (54.7% vs 45.3%). Faces incumbent Lance Gooden (R) in November. Rated Solid R.

Open seat (Al Green moved to TX-18). Alex Mealer (R) won the May 26 Republican primary runoff over Briscoe Cain (69.3% vs 30.7%). Lorenzo Gutierrez (D) won the D primary outright in March. Rated Solid R.
Thurman Bartie (D) won the May 26 Democratic primary runoff over Richard Davis (51.9% vs 48.1%). Faces incumbent Randy Weber (R) in November. Rated Solid R.
Veronica Escobar (D) is the incumbent. Adam Bauman (R) won the May 26 Republican primary runoff over Manuel Barraza (69.9% vs 30.1%). Rated Solid D.
Open seat (Jodey Arrington retired). Tom Sell (R) won the May 26 Republican primary runoff over Abraham Enriquez (65.6% vs 34.4%). Faces Democrat Kyle Rable in November. Rated Solid R.
Open seat (redrawn district). Patrick Gillespie (R) won the May 26 Republican primary runoff over John Sims (56.2% vs 43.8%). Faces Democrat Dan Barrios in November. Rated Lean R.

Open seat (newly drawn district). Colin Allred (D) won the May 26 Democratic primary runoff over incumbent Julie Johnson (54.9% vs 45.1%). Patrick David Gillespie (R) won the R runoff over John Sims (56.2% vs 43.8%). Rated Solid D.

Open seat (Greg Casar moved to TX-37). Carlos De La Cruz (R) won the May 26 Republican primary runoff over John Lujan (54.5% vs 45.5%). Johnny Garcia (D) won the D runoff over Maureen Galindo (59.2% vs 40.8%). Rated Likely R.
Greg Casar (D) is the incumbent (moved from old TX-35 after redistricting). Lauren Peña (R) won the May 26 Republican primary runoff over Ge'Nell Gary (58.4% vs 41.6%). Rated Solid D.
Open seat. Jon Bonck (R) won the May 26 Republican primary runoff over Shelly deZevallos (65.4% vs 34.6%). Faces Democrat Melissa McDonough in November. Rated Solid R.
